chunks: They say: "There is no other life but that of this world, and we will not be raised (from the dead)."
ai.seo_question: What do disbelievers say about life and resurrection according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to illustrate the materialistic worldview of the disbelievers who equate existence solely with the temporal world, thereby rejecting the metaphysical reality of the Akhira (Hereafter). It underscores the theological necessity of resurrection (Ba'th) as a counter to their claim of finality in earthly life, a concept central to Imam Ali's arguments in Nahj al-Balagha regarding the signs of the Creator.
